items.note: assumption: that the 750 is gross rather than net. Cross-check, not a derivation: 750,00 less the labour's gross 177,12 leaves 572,88 for parts against USD 600,99, which implies about 1,05 USD/EUR - a plausible 2024 rate. No FX rate is used to produce the figure; it comes from his own 750.
